attachments.insertion_landmark: jugular process of the occipital bone

actions: bends the head laterally to the same side

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Lies immediately in front of the jugular foramen, so it is a surgical landmark for CN IX, X and XI at the skull base.
